description: This file defines the PersonalizeEventsClient class for interacting with the Amazon Personalize Events service using the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for actions such as putActionInteractions, putActions, putEvents, putItems, and putUsers, along with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: PersonalizeEventsClient
classes.description: A client class used to communicate with the Amazon Personalize Events service.

methods.name: putActionInteractions
methods.description: Records interactions of users with items.

methods.name: putEvents
methods.description: Records events related to user interactions.
